facts.text: Founded as a women's college in 1916 by philanthropist Margaret Olivia Slocum Sage, Russell Sage College continues its dedication to women's empowerment through its Women's Institute.

sources.title: The Denise Taber Finard '80 Women's Institute | Russell Sage College
sources.quote: When Margaret Olivia Slocum Sage founded Russell Sage College in 1916, it was an act of disruption. She believed educating women was essential to positive societal change.
